items.t: SAP Executives to Participate in Upcoming Investor Events
items.sum: SAP SE (NYSE: SAP) today announced the participation of its executive at the following events. The events will be webcast, and the replay will be made available shortly afterwards on the SAP Investor Relations website: https://www.sap.com/investors/en/financial-documents-and-events/events.html

items.t: SAP and VFC Open Intelligent Fashion Store
items.sum: SAP SE (NYSE: SAP) and VF Corporation (NYSE: VFC) today opened S.Fashion, a retail innovation space at the SAP headquarters in Walldorf designed to explore how AI-enabled, end-to-end processes can enhance the consumer experience while making store operations more effective.

items.t: SAP Stocks Rise 1.73% After JPMorgan Upgrade on AI Production Shift
items.sum: JPMorgan moves SAP to Overweight, arguing AI's shift from pilots to production favors systems of record.
